svg.title: Feedback and checking
svg.desc: What basis is provided for judging the work? Separate feedback about an attempt or progress, appraisals and status marks, and an active check against a reference. Source illustration: Persistent coverage bars and local unread-reference counts make progress through the literature visible.

text.tspan: What basis is provided for judging the work?
